stage: Initial research and data-feasibility design; no portfolio returns calculated
universe: Common shares (CS), primary exchange XNYS or XNAS, from historical reference snapshots at the previous month end. Membership fixed within each month; intramonth IPOs delayed. This is a declared causal universe adaptation, not the paper's exact CRSP universe.
direction: Opening candle direction; dojis excluded before ranking in this implementation
exit: Hard stop or scheduled regular-session close; no fixed profit target
feature_timing: Select only after the complete opening five minutes. Daily ATR, average volume and reference opening volume use completed prior sessions only. ATR implementation is the arithmetic mean of 14 true ranges, requiring 15 prior sessions for preceding closes. No today's high, low, close or full-day volume in selection.
corporate_actions: All source prices and volumes must share a verified share basis. For raw data, convert historical feature inputs into today's share units using only share events executed on or before the decision day. Never mix adjusted daily ATR with unadjusted intraday execution. Ticker changes and incomplete histories are conservatively excluded until sufficient same-ticker history exists.
proposed_portfolio_interpretation: Equal opening-equity allocations among selected stocks, 1% planned stop risk per allocation, whole shares, aggregate entry notional capped at 1x or 4x opening equity as separately disclosed scenarios. This is not 1% account risk on each of 20 simultaneous positions. Final execution/cost rules must be frozen before calculating portfolio returns.
planned_controls: Preserve unfiltered ORB and a prior-volume-ranked selection as explicit controls; compare relative-volume selection without optimizing a threshold or target to reach a desired daily return.
retention: One compressed source object at a time; preserve compact summaries, source identity/hash and separately selected intraday extracts. Raw scratch files are removed only after successful extraction and verification. Do not duplicate existing research datasets.
limitations: Pilot is retrospective, short and not an untouched holdout. Short availability/locates, bid-ask spreads, latency, entry-minute stops, gap fills, closing executions and portfolio allocation need explicit treatment before any live-feasibility claim. No claim of 1%-2% daily returns.
